edge="1" parent="1" source="StsClient" target="SecureTokenService"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"></mxGeometry></mxCell><mxCell id="require_caller" value="<b>require_caller</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[fn, auth.rs]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">Middleware on every DSP route: runs the verifier on the Authorization header. A refused caller gets 404 on negotiation and transfer routes, 401 on catalog routes (refusal_status); 503 if the check cannot finish</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#85BBF0;strokeColor=#78A8D8;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=component;c4Name=require_caller;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="50" y="130" width="290" height="120" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="CallerVerifier" value="<b>trait CallerVerifier</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[port, auth.rs]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">verify: who calls, with which credentials. credentials: more scopes for a policy</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF2CC;strokeColor=#D6B656;dashed=1;dashPattern=5 3;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=port;c4Name=trait CallerVerifier;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="430" y="130" width="320" height="140" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="RefuseAll" value="<b>RefuseAll</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[auth.rs]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">Default: refuses every caller</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#85BBF0;strokeColor=#78A8D8;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=component;c4Name=RefuseAll;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="840" y="120" width="210" height="70" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="TckVerifier" value="<b>TckVerifier</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[tck.rs, feature tck]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">DSP TCK only, never released</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#85BBF0;strokeColor=#78A8D8;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=component;c4Name=TckVerifier;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="840" y="215" width="210" height="70" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="with_linked_scopes" value="<b>with_linked_scopes</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[fn, auth.rs]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">The scopes asked for, plus, for each scope of the Gaia-X compliance credential type, the legal person scope with the same alias and access: a compliance credential counts only with the legal person credential it names. StsProver grants the same</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#85BBF0;strokeColor=#78A8D8;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=component;c4Name=with_linked_scopes;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="1140" y="115" width="360" height="150" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="handlers" value="<b>Provider, TransferProvider</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[structs, negotiation.rs, transfer.rs]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">DSP handlers: when an offer or agreement has credential constraints, they ask for those credentials first</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#85BBF0;strokeColor=#78A8D8;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=component;c4Name=Provider, TransferProvider;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="50" y="380" width="290" height="130" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="DcpVerifier" value="<b>DcpVerifier</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[struct, dcp.rs]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">DCP v1.0.1: checks the caller&#x27;s self-issued ID token, asks its Credential Service for presentations (PresentationQueryMessage), requires a membership credential; all within 20 s</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">Each presentation is split (takes_gaiax_checks): Gaia-X compliance and legal person credentials from issuers not in PORTITOR_TRUSTED_ISSUERS go to check_gaiax; the others count only from a trusted issuer and must be about the caller (holder binding)</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#85BBF0;strokeColor=#78A8D8;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=component;c4Name=DcpVerifier;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="430" y="380" width="320" height="380" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="SecureTokenService" value="<b>trait SecureTokenService</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[port, sts.rs]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">Our ID token, carrying the caller&#x27;s access token</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF2CC;strokeColor=#D6B656;dashed=1;dashPattern=5 3;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=port;c4Name=trait SecureTokenService;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="880" y="370" width="280" height="90" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="StsClient" value="<b>StsClient</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[sts.rs]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">POST to our identity&#x27;s STS</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#85BBF0;strokeColor=#78A8D8;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=component;c4Name=StsClient;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="1250" y="375" width="220" height="80" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="DidWebResolver" value="<b>DidWebResolver</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[struct, portitor-runtime did.rs]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">DID documents of callers and issuers, cached</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#85BBF0;strokeColor=#78A8D8;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=component;c4Name=DidWebResolver;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="880" y="475" width="280" height="90" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="HttpSender" value="<b>HttpSender</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[struct, portitor-runtime http.rs]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">Presentation query, status lists: HTTPS, size limits, no redirects</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#85BBF0;strokeColor=#78A8D8;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=component;c4Name=HttpSender;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="880" y="580" width="280" height="90" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="check_gaiax" value="<b>DcpVerifier::check_gaiax</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[fn, dcp.rs; ADR 0022]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">A Gaia-X compliance credential counts only from a service in gaiax_compliance_issuers (AuthSettings, PORTITOR_GAIAX_COMPLIANCE_ISSUERS); others are skipped before any fetch. It needs validUntil, the service&#x27;s signature, its stated dates and status, and must name by digestSRI a legal person credential of the same presentation, issued and signed by the caller (its status not fetched); unnamed ones are skipped. Holder binding is skipped for these two only</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#85BBF0;strokeColor=#78A8D8;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=component;c4Name=DcpVerifier::check_gaiax;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="880" y="700" width="380" height="200" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="ComplianceCheck" value="<b>ComplianceCheck</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[struct, dcp.rs]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">A checked compliance credential, the digestSRI of each credential it names, and whether the presentation holds one (linked); if not, the caller is refused</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#85BBF0;strokeColor=#78A8D8;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=component;c4Name=ComplianceCheck;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="1330" y="700" width="180" height="200" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="credentials_for" value="<b>credentials_for</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[fn, auth.rs]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">The scopes the policy needs (credential_scopes), then the verifier&#x27;s credentials; a failed query gives none</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#85BBF0;strokeColor=#78A8D8;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=component;c4Name=credentials_for;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="50" y="700" width="290" height="120" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="validate_self_issued" value="<b>validate_self_issued</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[fn, id_token.rs]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">Signed with the caller&#x27;s key, aud is us, iss = sub, not expired, jti used once (JtiCache)</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#85BBF0;strokeColor=#78A8D8;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=component;c4Name=validate_self_issued;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="400" y="990" width="240" height="170" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="Presentation" value="<b>Presentation, Credential</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[structs, credential.rs, status_list.rs]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">Signatures; the presentation&#x27;s holder is the caller, and so is each credential&#x27;s subject (is_only_about), except for the Gaia-X compliance and legal person credentials; valid now, or by validFrom and validUntil only (verify_stated_dates); the status list bit: not revoked or suspended</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#85BBF0;strokeColor=#78A8D8;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=component;c4Name=Presentation, Credential;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="670" y="990" width="340" height="170" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="gaiax" value="<b>gaiax::compliant_credentials, digest_sri_of, matches_scope_type</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[fns, gaiax.rs]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">The ids and digestSRI a compliance credential lists (gx:compliantCredentials); sha256- of a credential&#x27;s JCS payload; a scope type T also names gx:T under a Gaia-X @context, so policies name gx: types without the prefix</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#85BBF0;strokeColor=#78A8D8;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=component;c4Name=gaiax::compliant_credentials, digest_sri_of, matches_scope_type;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="1050" y="990" width="440" height="170" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="CallerCredentials" value="<b>CallerCredentials</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[struct, credentials.rs]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">The configured credential types and the caller&#x27;s verified credentials (HeldCredential)</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#85BBF0;strokeColor=#78A8D8;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=component;c4Name=CallerCredentials;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="60" y="1265" width="280" height="120" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="permissions_hold" value="<b>permissions_hold</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[fn, policy.rs]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">Do the permissions hold now for this caller: dateTime and credential constraints; svg.text: C4 Code: DSP caller authentication with DCP
Who calls a DSP endpoint, checked with DCP (Gaia-X compliance credentials too, ADR 0022), and the caller's credentials when a policy asks for them
Middleware on every DSP route: runs the verifier on
the Authorization header. A refused caller gets 404 on
negotiation and transfer routes, 401 on catalog routes
verify: who calls, with which credentials. credentials: more
The scopes asked for, plus, for each scope of the Gaia-X compliance
credential type, the legal person scope with the same alias and
access: a compliance credential counts only with the legal person
credential it names. StsProver grants the same
DSP handlers: when an offer or agreement has
credential constraints, they ask for those credentials
DCP v1.0.1: checks the caller's self-issued ID token, asks its
compliance and legal person credentials from issuers not in
others count only from a trusted issuer and must be about the
Our ID token, carrying the caller's access token
DID documents of callers and issuers, cached
Presentation query, status lists: HTTPS, size limits,
A Gaia-X compliance credential counts only from a service in
before any fetch. It needs validUntil, the service's signature, its stated
dates and status, and must name by digestSRI a legal person credential
of the same presentation, issued and signed by the caller (its status not
fetched); unnamed ones are skipped. Holder binding is skipped for these
The scopes the policy needs (credential_scopes), then
the verifier's credentials; a failed query gives none
Signed with the caller's key, aud is us, iss =
sub, not expired, jti used once (JtiCache)
Signatures; the presentation's holder is the caller, and so is each
credential's subject (is_only_about), except for the Gaia-X
compliance and legal person credentials; valid now, or by
validFrom and validUntil only (verify_stated_dates); the status list
The ids and digestSRI a compliance credential lists (gx:compliantCredentials);
sha256- of a credential's JCS payload; a scope type T also names gx:T under a
Gaia-X @context, so policies name gx: types without the prefix
The configured credential types and the caller's
Do the permissions hold now for this caller: dateTime and
credential constraints; a claim path may hold ':' (a Gaia-X
claim such as gx:labelLevel); anything not understood fails
Check the offer or the agreement before they agree or

C4 model, level 4. Solid arrows: uses. Dashed arrows: implements. One credential that fails its checks makes its whole presentation invalid, and the caller is refused (DCP 5.4.3). Credentials from issuers not trusted (dataspace or Gaia-X compliance) are skipped (ADR 0022).
